thread:
laura_sales: Heads up - Trial tenant at Globex hitting 403s intermittently during their integration test. They
re using our JS SDK server-side. Demo scheduled for Friday. Can someone triage?
devin_engineer: Can you paste the error payload from their logs? 403 could be org mismatch or missing scope.
laura_sales: From their logs:
```
HTTP 403 
{"error":{"code":"forbidden","message":"key does not have access to project or org"}}
```
They
id try rotating keys earlier in the day. Key visible in their config: sk_org_temp_zz99
kai_ops: If it's sk_org_ it should work across projects in the org unless it was created with restricted scopes. Two quick checks: 1) ensure X-Redwood-Org header matches the org slug exactly, 2) check key scopes include inference:generate or embeddings:create depending on endpoint
devin_engineer: Also double-check their SDK init - if they passed a projectId into the client config the SDK will attach X-Redwood-Project which can cause a mismatch when used with an org-key that doesn't list that project in allowed_projects. Ask for the request headers they send.
laura_sales: They sent headers snippet:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_org_temp_zz99
X-Redwood-Org: globex-inc
X-Redwood-Project: project-labs
User-Agent: globex-internal/1.2.0
```
nina_support: Looks like the org-key was created with a project allowlist (we have that feature for trial security). Ian see in the console that sk_org_temp_zz99 is restricted to project-main only, not project-labs. I can either expand the allowlist or they can remove X-Redwood-Project from requests so the org routing applies to org default project. Which is preferred for the demo?
laura_sales: Demo needs to show multiple projects; better to expand allowlist temporarily. Can you toggle that, Nina?
nina_support: Doing it now. Also noticed a rate limiter entry earlier - infra-bot shows several 429s at 13:42UTC from the same IP during a scripted load test. If they hit 429 then throttling can mask auth failures in the client logs. I'll clear the rate limiter for their tenant window so demo traffic won't get throttled.
infra-bot: ACTION: temporarily lifted tenant rate limit for globex-inc for 60 minutes (by request of nina_support). Audit id: rl-20260312-001
devin_engineer: Once Nina flips the allowlist and rate limit, ask them to retry and send raw curl (no SDK) so we can see exact behavior. Sample curl to try:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_org_temp_zz99" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: globex-inc" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
laura_sales: They retried and now get 200 on the curl. :white_check_mark: Thanks all. Can we add a one-line note to the trial playbook about org-key allowlists and SDK project injection so new trials don't get stuck?
nina_support: Yup creating KB short note now. I
lso rotated the temp org key post-testing and issued a fresh org key with the correct allowlist; pinged laura with the new secret via secure DM.
devin_engineer: For long term recommend server-side token proxy to avoid leaking org keys to client code + standard check in onboarding script to verify headers and scopes.
laura_sales: Great — closing this thread. Thanks team :raised_hands:
